title: Dreams Shattered
next_chapter_hook: The fleeting guilt in Mo Xiansheng's eyes—could it hide what truth? And why is the Tianji Record in Chen Ji's hand trembling strangely at this moment?

text.content:
Deep night, in the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds.

Ye Qing sat cross-legged by the Blood Pool, demonic aura churning around her like a raging tide. This was the sensation she had known best for fourteen years—the demonic path mist flowing through her meridians, like an invisible chain, guiding every breath she took.

She closed her eyes, attempting to enter deeper meditation. However, tonight's demonic energy was restless and uneasy, as if something was summoning her.

A blurry image flashed through her mind—a infant in swaddling clothes, placed into the Blood Pool by a pale hand. The baby did not cry, merely gazing with eyes dark as ink, quietly staring into the void.

Ye Qing's eyes snapped open, cold sweat soaking her back.

"What was that..." Her voice echoed through the empty forbidden grounds, carrying uncontrollable trembling.

The baby's face bore a faint resemblance to her own.

She took a deep breath, trying to calm her emotions. Cultivation demands a tranquil heart; any distracting thoughts could lead to demonic deviation. Yet that image was like a thorn, deeply embedded in the depths of her consciousness—the harder she tried to pull it out, the deeper it pierced.

The demonic aura in the Blood Pool suddenly churned violently, and a ghostly blue light rose from the pool's depths, slowly merging into her Brow Center.

Ye Qing shuddered violently, and the world before her suddenly changed—she saw another self.

dialogue.content:
It was a vast secret chamber, its walls covered with dense arrays of runes. In the chamber's center, a figure in black robes was murmuring something before a crystal container.

"...The Heavenly Fate Lock and Key Plan has been initiated. The seventh test subject has been implanted with the Demonic Path Mist core and can be activated at any time."

Inside the crystal container was unmistakably that infant in swaddling clothes—those pitch-black eyes, identical to Ye Qing's at this very moment.

"No!" Ye Qing screamed, yet found herself unable to move. The vision continued playing, as if someone had pressed the play button.

text.content:
Images flickered like a carousel.

The infant was delivered to the Holy Sect, given the title of "Saintess." She was taught loyalty to the Holy Sect, to propagate the Demonic Path. Every choice, every "moment of enlightenment," was marked on an invisible chessboard.

She saw her seven-year-old self "accidentally" obtaining the Demonic Path Mist—that was no accident, but a trap laid long ago.

She saw the scene at thirteen when she was told "You are the chosen one"—that was no honor, but a shackle.

She saw behind countless instances of "fate's guidance," an invisible hand controlling everything.

"No... this can't be true..."

Ye Qing knelt at the Blood Pool's edge, both hands gripping the rocks so tightly her knuckles turned white from force. Her entire body trembled, tears uncontrollable streaming from her eyes.

Twenty-three years. She had lived twenty-three years, believing she controlled her fate, believing she was writing a legend.

In the end, she was merely a vessel designed by others.

A tool.

A chess piece.

dialogue.content:
"You've finally seen it."

An aged and weary voice sounded behind her. Ye Qing spun around to see Mo Xiansheng's phantom hovering in mid-air, his face appearing especially old in the dim light.

"You've known all along?" Her voice was hoarse, carrying suppressed fury and despair, "You took me as your disciple, taught me cultivation techniques, told me those truths about fate—all to manipulate me?"

Mo Xiansheng did not answer, merely watching her silently, a complex emotion flickering in his eyes.

choice.prompt: Facing Mo Xiansheng's silence, Ye Qing's heart felt like it had fallen into an icy abyss. She wanted answers, wanted a reason that would allow her to continue trusting, or perhaps... she only wanted a thorough release.

choices.description: What Ye Qing wanted was not silence, but answers. However cruel those answers might be, she had to see this chessboard of fate with her own eyes.
choices.risk_hint: The Truth May Be More Cruel Than Imagined

text.content: "Answer me!" Ye Qing's voice echoed through the forbidden grounds, carrying decisive sharpness, "How much of my life has been real?"

Mo Xiansheng sighed, that sigh seemingly carrying the weariness of a thousand years: "You are real. Your emotions are real. That Ye Qing who was willing to oppose the entire Holy Sect for atrash—that Ye Qing is real."

choices.description: Chen Ji made her see these things—what does he really want? To recruit her or to play with her emotions?
choices.visible_cost: May Destroy the Alliance with Chen Ji
choices.visible_reward: See One's Position on the Opponent's Chessboard
choices.risk_hint: The Answer May Cause Her to Lose Her Last Ally

text.content: "Chen Ji... why did he want me to see these?" Ye Qing's gaze suddenly turned sharp, "What exactly is he trying to do?"
Mo Xiansheng was silent for a moment before speaking softly: "Because he wants you to be free. Truly free."

choices.description: If even her life was arranged, what right does she have to speak of freedom? What is the meaning of her existence?
choices.visible_reward: Obtain an Opportunity to Break Through the Heart Demon
choices.risk_hint: If Unable to Escape the Shadows, Cultivation Will Stall

text.content: Ye Qing slowly lowered her head, her voice becoming hollow: "What... what of mine is real?"
Mo Xiansheng's phantom drifted closer, his voice unusually gentle: "Child, fate gave you a script, but how you perform it is your own right."

Mo Xiansheng's phantom slowly drifted before her, a bitter smile appearing on his aged face.

"I know what you're thinking." His voice was low and weary, "You're wondering why, knowing all this, I still took you as my disciple, why I let you believe those lies about defying fate."

Ye Qing lifted her head sharply, eyes burning with an intertwined light of fury and pain.

"Isn't that the case?" Her voice was ragged, "You exploited my trust in fate, manipulated me to serve the Holy Sect—"

"No." Mo Xiansheng cut her off, "I was teaching you how to break it."

"Break it?" Ye Qing coldly laughed, "I can't even control my own life. What do I have to break it with?"

Mo Xiansheng said nothing, merely raising his hand as light materialized in the void. Within that light appeared an intricate chessboard, countless points of light flickering upon it.

"This is the Heavenly Eye's chessboard." Mo Xiansheng pointed to those points of light, "Every point is a manipulated fate. And you—"

He pointed to a faint yet stubbornly flickering point of light at the board's edge.

"You are the only chess piece with a crack."

choice.prompt: "A crack"? What did this mean? Ye Qing felt confused, yet from the depths of her heart arose a flicker of hope—perhaps she was not completely without a way out.

choices.text: Asking About the Meaning of the Crack
choices.description: Ye Qing wanted to know what this "crack" was—her flaw, or her hidden weapon?
choices.visible_reward: Obtain Key Information About One's Own Truth
choices.risk_hint: The Answer May Completely Change Her Self-Perception

text.content: Mo Xiansheng pointed to the darkness surrounding that point of light: "The other chess pieces are perfect circles, representing complete control. But you—you were born with a fissure. This crack makes you impossible to fully predict, creating a flaw in the Heavenly Eye's control."

choices.description: She dares not trust anyone, especially this man who knew everything yet chose silence.
choices.risk_hint: His words may be a trap

dialogue.content: "How do you prove what you say is true?" Ye Qing's voice was ice-cold, "You stayed silent for twenty-three years. Now telling me this—are you trying to continue manipulating me?"

text.content: Mo Xiansheng gave a bitter smile: "I have no way to prove it. But you should know—I never speak words without meaning."

Ye Qing stared blankly at that faintly flickering point of light, her heart churning with unspeakable emotions.

For twenty-three years, she had believed herself to be heaven's favored daughter, chosen by fate. She was proud, she was strong, she不允许 herself any weakness.

It turned out her pride was from the beginning a prop designed by others.

It turned out her strength was merely the beautiful feathers of a caged bird.

But that "crack"—that was the only real part of her.

"So... does Chen Ji know about these things?" Ye Qing's voice was hoarse, "He showed me those memories on purpose?"

Mo Xiansheng nodded, then shook his head: "He knows part of it. But he showed you, hoping you would make your own choice—whether to continue being a perfect chess piece, or to become that cracked, imperfect self."

Ye Qing closed her eyes, tears streaming down her cheeks.

She thought of Chen Ji. Thattrash, that disciple servant scorned by everyone. He had used the Tianji Record to show her a prophecy, and shocked, she chose to cooperate.

Now she understood—he wasn't using her, he was giving her a chance.

"What should I do?" She opened her eyes, the confusion in her gaze gradually replaced by a certain determination.

Mo Xiansheng looked at her, a glimmer of relief flickering in his eyes: "You have three choices."

He raised one finger: "Continue pretending you know nothing, seeking self-preservation within the Holy Sect's chess game—"

A second finger: "Use what you know to stir up trouble within the Holy Sect, but this path has nine deaths and one life."

A third finger: "Find Chen Ji and truly ally with him. But you must know—he is also a piece on the chessboard—just one who wants to overturn the board."

choice.prompt: Three paths lay before her, each leading into an unknown abyss. Ye Qing felt unprecedented confusion, but also unprecedented clarity—this was the first time she truly decided her own fate.

choices.description: Pretend she knows nothing, accumulate strength within the Holy Sect, wait for a better opportunity. This was the path she knew best.
choices.risk_hint: Long-term performance may cause her to lose herself again

text.content: Ye Qing took a deep breath, pushing all emotions back into her heart: "I understand. I will continue being my Saintess—at least until they discover the truth."
Mo Xiansheng nodded, his phantom beginning to fade: "Remember, the crack is your greatest advantage. Protect it."

choices.description: Use everything she knows to create chaos within the Holy Sect. Even if she fails, those puppeteers must pay the price.
choices.visible_reward: Throw the Holy Sect into chaos, make a name for herself
choices.risk_hint: Success rate extremely low, may lead to eternal damnation

dialogue.content: "I refuse to be a chess piece any longer." Ye Qing's voice was ice-cold and resolute, "I will let them know—chess pieces can also bite back."

text.content: Mo Xiansheng let out a long sigh: "You will fail. But perhaps... failure itself is also a choice."

choices.description: Find thattrash who wants to overturn the chessboard, truly ally with him. She wants to know what qualification he has to challenge heaven.
choices.visible_cost: Hand one's fate over to another
choices.visible_reward: Obtain a true ally, step closer to freedom
choices.risk_hint: Whether Chen Ji can be trusted remains an unknown

dialogue.content: "I want to see Chen Ji." Ye Qing's gaze was firm, "I want to know what qualifies him to challenge this game."

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's phantom suddenly trembled—at that instant, Ye Qing caught a flash of guilt deep in his eyes. That was not guilt over exposed lies, but something deeper, something unspeakable.

The guilt that flashed in Mo Xiansheng's eyes vanished in an instant, yet it struck Ye Qing's heart like thunder.

That was not the embarrassment of a exposed lie, but something deeper—something like a debt, like helplessness, like a predestined tragedy.

"Your eyes..." Ye Qing's voice trembled slightly, "What are you hiding?"

Mo Xiansheng gave no answer. His phantom began to dissipate, his voice coming from all directions, ethereal and distant: "Remember, the crack is your greatest weapon. But it is also your greatest weakness."

"Chen Ji... he also has a crack in him."

The words fell, and Mo Xiansheng's figure vanished completely.

Ye Qing knelt alone by the Blood Pool, moonlight casting down, illuminating her pale yet resolute features.

Chen Ji. Thattrash. That man she once thought was only using her.

He also has a crack?

Ye Qing slowly stood up, wiping away her tears. The demonic aura in the Blood Pool still churned, but now in her eyes, those once-familiar black mists had become so foreign.

Her fingers gently brushed her Brow Center, where the Demonic Path Mist core had once been implanted.

"From today," she said quietly, her voice cold as ice, "I am no one's chess piece."

In the distant direction of the Tianqing Sect, the Tianji Record Fragment emitted a faint tremor—as if sensing something.
